exposure: infantile hemangiomatosis with widespread cutaneous, oral mucosal, splenic, and hepatic involvement
outcome: increase in number and size of lesions
decrease in size and disappearance of hemangiomas
regression of hepatic and splenic hemangiomas
cohort: A single infant diagnosed with multifocal infantile hemangiomatosis affecting skin, oral mucosa, liver, and spleen.
finding: Prompt intervention and careful therapy adjustment can lead to favorable outcomes even in the setting of extensive visceral involvement for multifocal infantile hemangiomatosis.
